meta.name: dile-components
meta.description: Use when building or modifying UI with the Dile Components library (@dile/ui, @dile/crud, @dile/editor, @dile/utils, @dile/lib, @dile/iconlib, @dile/icons) — a framework-agnostic, Lit-based web component catalog. Trigger when installing/importing dile-* custom elements, using tags like <dile-input>, <dile-modal>, <dile-table>, building CRUD screens, adding a WYSIWYG/Markdown editor, using icon components, or theming with Dile's CSS custom properties.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Dile 组件库快速搭建 UI 界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 Dile 组件库构建 Web 界面
copy.tagline_en: Build UI quickly with Dile component library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building web interfaces with the Dile component library

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你使用 Dile Components 库中的 Web 组件（如输入框、弹窗、表格、富文本编辑器等）来构建或修改用户界面。它会指导你安装、导入组件，并提醒你查阅官方文档获取准确的 API 信息。
howto.when: 当你在项目中需要添加或修改 UI 组件，特别是使用 Dile 系列组件（如 <dile-input>、<dile-modal>、<dile-table>）或构建 CRUD 界面、编辑器、图标时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 @dile/ui 添加一个带标签的输入框。
我想用 @dile/crud 做一个简单的用户管理 CRUD 页面。
say.note: Claude 会提供安装和基本使用步骤。

say.text: 如何用 @dile/editor 集成一个 Markdown 编辑器？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use web components from the Dile Components library (e.g., inputs, modals, tables, rich text editor) to build or modify UI. It guides you on installation, import, and reminds you to check official docs for accurate API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add or modify UI components in a project, especially using Dile components like <dile-input>, <dile-modal>, <dile-table>, or building CRUD screens, editors, icons.

say_en.text: Help me add an input with a label using @dile/ui.
say_en.note: Claude will guide installation and import of <dile-input>.

say_en.text: I want to build a simple user management CRUD page with @dile/crud.
say_en.note: Claude will provide installation and basic usage steps.

say_en.text: How to integrate a Markdown editor with @dile/editor?
say_en.note: Claude will explain installation and import of <dile-editor>.
